defect_resolution.description: Normalize only the verified macOS system temporary-root alias before component-aware containment checks; retain lstat checks for every descendant and do not resolve arbitrary symlinks.

expected_behavior: A missing result descendant lexically beneath the approved evaluation root is accepted after both paths use the same verified macOS temporary-root identity.
observed_behavior: Foundation standardized the existing /private/tmp evaluation root through the verified /tmp alias but retained /private/tmp for the missing result descendant, so containment rejected the worker before task execution with resultOutsideEvaluationRoot and the pipeline stopped as canary_nonzero_exit.
proposed_rerun_scope: Rerun the entire page batch from the first canary attempt only after the owner approves this invalid classification and a replacement D6 manifest plus its external freeze commit.
reproduction_steps: Use the approved macOS evaluation root /private/tmp/swift-claw-evaluation/scheduled-task-learning/page-change after that root exists.
Validate a not-yet-created result descendant whose lexical path starts with the same /private/tmp root.
Observe Foundation standardize the existing root to /tmp while retaining /private/tmp for the missing descendant before the corrected identity normalization.
Run the reserved canary worker invocation and observe resultOutsideEvaluationRoot before any file_read or Responses send.
sealed_set_disposition: The sealed set remained unopened and may be reused only under a new owner-approved manifest.
violated_frozen_rule: The frozen evaluation workspace and result path are inside the approved evaluation root; a trusted system alias must not cause a lexically contained path to fail the component-aware containment boundary.
